column1: # the install from a DSU try: every trigger needs ro.gsid.image_running=1, the props carry ro.lumen.dsu_install=1
# the public release: the one blobs reader of every model (tools/ota/image/z9x_blobs.sh) with the HB's settings
# (blobs.conf) binds the user's own copies (blobs_allow.txt names them) from the z9x_blobs partition, and in a trial run
# reads them from the stock slot (else the vendor HWC waits forever for IInterTunnel on the first HDMI frame)
# the OTA client: gate files, HB gate data and props, bootctl, otacerts, updater
# ---- the base: the pinned Play 6 LineageOS 21 gsi_tv_arm userdebug build (patches 0001-0006, 2026-10-24)
# 0a. the base's own boot image and system_server odex are the soong dexpreopt_arm output of this build
# 1. APEX modules uncompressed (apexd would unpack every .capex during post-fs-data, late for the PWM watchdog)
# 1b. rule S1: the base's platform set, the four APEXes with a platform APK and mac_permissions, signed on the Mac
# 2. debloat (the shared GSI list, the HB lines, the launcher in the Lumen images); TvProvision stays in t1 (it provisions the device there), the Lumen images drop it
# 3. added files: owner root, labels from the file contexts at mkfs time (5)
#   3a. XGIMI's vendor apps hidden before the package scan
#   3b. the fastbootd escape (every image), the USB-stick boot logger (--diag only)
#   3c. network adb on the stick variant only
# Files (apps/LumenFiles, org.lumen.files): the file manager of every model in place of the stock one; a priv-app, so the
# package installer takes its APKs as a trusted source (one confirm window), no privileged permission, no permissions file
# screen casting on every model (2026-11-21): the Miracast sink (apps/LumenMiracast, priv-app with its privileged and
# default permissions; org.lumen.miracast runs from the first boot through z9x-sysconfig-nogms.xml) and the Wi-Fi
# Direct device type TV (apps/LumenWifiP2pOverlay, static RRO); the stock vendor starts wpa_supplicant with p2p0
# the system package installer in the Lumen look (apps/LumenPackageInstallerOverlay, static RRO, no dex): the GSI's TV
# theme puts the uninstall guided step into a floating dialog (one letter per line), this overlay fixes it for every model
# the on-screen keyboard of every model: Lumen Keyboard (apps/LumenKeyboard, the LeanbackIME package with keyboard
# languages and a language key) in LeanbackIME's place; the base's odex of the old APK goes
# the video player of every model: Lumen Play (com.xgimiru.player) as its published APK with its own key, so its own
# updates install over it, a plain system app with its libraries unpacked and its licence notice (DLNA renderer and
# browser send from the first boot: tools/build/prebuilt.py, devices/_image/prebuilt.tsv, build.conf prebuilt=)
# the stock model properties (hb_model_props.rc: the XGIMI init loads vendor/etc/xgimimodelname/<model>/build.prop,
# LineageOS init does not), one block per model and firmware, each file proven against its stock dump file
# Lumen Setup is HOME on wiped data; the projector app is the persistent system-uid app, no HbBoot
#   t10: MediaTek's VNDK copy for codec2 (test images); the public release binds the user's own copy instead
#   Bluetooth: the base's libbluetooth_jni.so with SBC at 44.1 kHz, bound over the APEX copy (hb_bt.rc)
#   3e. the public image: the OTA client

column1: #   3f. the Google sign-in helper (lineage/gmsprops, devices/_image/gmsprops): the 32-bit library and init helper
#   built on the host by lineage/gmsprops/build.sh (pinned), its rc and data file; after the OTA block, whose 'only'
#   check of /system/etc/lumen comes first. The rc must start the check-in service after boot
#   3g. the HDMI receiver bridge of the signal panel (apps/core/lumen-signal/image, devices/goat_elegant/signal.tsv
#   hdmi_format): a root oneshot that asks the MStar receiver for its info dump and leaves the info lines for the app;
#   after the OTA block like the sign-in helper, whose 'only' check of /system/etc/lumen comes first
#   3h. the problem report log helper of every image (apps/core/lumen-report/image, staged for every device by
# tools/build/build.py COMMON_FILES): a root oneshot that hands the report app the scrubbed system log without a dialog
# Lumen's power-on sound: init copies the projector app's gate to persist.sys.bootanim.play_sound (lumen-audio BootSound)
# 3z. --dsu-test: network adb during a DSU try with the build host's adb PUBLIC key
# the one first-start setting of every image (devices/_image/first_start_prop.txt: English, the time zone from the network)
# 4b. every APK and APEX of the finished tree, for the S1 check on the Mac (sign_device.py goat_elegant check-image)
# 5. erofs: labels from the system's own file contexts (plat + system_ext + product), one time, a UUID from TAG
# 6. the image against the base: every entry, only the debloat, APEXes, added files and props may differ
# 7. size budget: the stock system_a (688,357,376) plus about 1.34 GB free in super
# the root copy is ~1.6 GB of root-owned files: removed, the image and the logs stay
